premises.text: Contextual communication (progress, social context, competition, game loops) drives highly engaged web audiences at the right moment
premises.evidence_span: They use contextual communication to the user to drive behavior at that right moment in time

premises.text: Only a handful of sites have these engagement capabilities; publishers lack tools to recognize and reward loyalty online
premises.evidence_span: it's outrageous that a handful of sites get to have these kinds of capabilities

premises.text: Badgeville is a loyalty/rewards platform using game mechanics so publishers define valued behaviors and rewards flexibly
premises.evidence_span: We're a loyalty and rewards platform for web publishers to drive engagement

premises.text: Platform embeds into registration, powers achievements, leaderboards, profiles, social share/invite, and admin-defined behaviors with widgets/API
premises.evidence_span: we plug in directly into your registration system

premises.text: Engagement analytics show top users, valued behaviors, community health, and friction points beyond page views
premises.evidence_span: it's not about page views anymore. It's about engagement, understanding your audience

premises.text: Huge publisher market: millions of sites already have Facebook social plugins—next step is behavior/rewards/loyalty layer

value.text: Maximize engagement for web publishers via loyalty, rewards, and recognition
value.evidence_span: We're here to maximize engagement for publishers

leverage proven techniques from game mechanics to give their users status and reputation
